chk_bundle_group_member_le_list.name: chk_bundle_group_member_le_list
chk_bundle_group_member_le_list.value: "mall_bundle_groups"."unit_member_price" IS NULL OR "mall_bundle_groups"."unit_list_price" IS NULL OR "mall_bundle_groups"."unit_member_price" <= "mall_bundle_groups"."unit_list_price"

chk_swu_leave_range.name: chk_swu_leave_range
chk_swu_leave_range.value: "staff_wechat_users"."leave_start" IS NULL OR "staff_wechat_users"."leave_end" IS NULL OR "staff_wechat_users"."leave_end" > "staff_wechat_users"."leave_start"

uq_sop_first_payment.name: uq_sop_first_payment
uq_sop_first_payment.where: change_type = '首次支付' AND status = '已支付'

chk_sop_amount_sign.name: chk_sop_amount_sign
chk_sop_amount_sign.value:
("sale_order_payments"."change_type" IN ('首次支付','回款','储值卡抵扣') AND "sale_order_payments"."amount" > 0)
          OR ("sale_order_payments"."change_type" = '退款' AND "sale_order_payments"."amount" <= 0)

chk_sop_method_txn.name: chk_sop_method_txn
chk_sop_method_txn.value: "sale_order_payments"."payment_method" NOT IN ('微信','支付宝') OR "sale_order_payments"."external_txn_id" IS NOT NULL

uq_sale_orders_client_pending.name: uq_sale_orders_client_pending
uq_sale_orders_client_pending.where: status = '待支付' AND client_user_id IS NOT NULL AND opened_by IS NULL

uq_sale_orders_phone_pending.name: uq_sale_orders_phone_pending
uq_sale_orders_phone_pending.where: status = '待支付' AND client_user_id IS NULL

uq_appt_sale_item_active.name: uq_appt_sale_item_active
uq_appt_sale_item_active.where: sale_item_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('待确认','已确认')

uq_appt_employee_time_active.name: uq_appt_employee_time_active
uq_appt_employee_time_active.where: employee_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('待确认','已确认')

uq_so_client_active.name: uq_so_client_active
uq_so_client_active.where: status NOT IN ('已完成','已取消')

uq_point_txn_order_user_type.name: uq_point_txn_order_user_type
uq_point_txn_order_user_type.where: ref_order_id IS NOT NULL AND type IN ('消费赠送','消费冲销')

chk_pt_amount_sign.name: chk_pt_amount_sign
chk_pt_amount_sign.value: ("point_transactions"."amount" < 0 AND "point_transactions"."type" IN ('消费冲销','消费抵扣','过期扣减')) OR "point_transactions"."amount" > 0

chk_inventory_cutover_states_status.name: chk_inventory_cutover_states_status
chk_inventory_cutover_states_status.value: "inventory_cutover_states"."status" IN ('待初始化','待核验','已初始化')

chk_inventory_docs_status.name: chk_inventory_docs_status
chk_inventory_docs_status.value: "inventory_docs"."status" IN ('草稿','待审批','待收货','已完成','已驳回','已取消')

chk_inventory_docs_location_pair.name: chk_inventory_docs_location_pair
chk_inventory_docs_location_pair.value:
"inventory_docs"."source_location_id" IS NULL
        OR "inventory_docs"."target_location_id" IS NULL
        OR "inventory_docs"."source_location_id" <> "inventory_docs"."target_location_id"

chk_inventory_promotion_qty_range.name: chk_inventory_promotion_qty_range
chk_inventory_promotion_qty_range.value:
"inventory_promotion_plan_items"."report_max_quantity" IS NULL
        OR "inventory_promotion_plan_items"."report_min_quantity" IS NULL
        OR "inventory_promotion_plan_items"."report_max_quantity" >= "inventory_promotion_plan_items"."report_min_quantity"

chk_inventory_skus_source_type.name: chk_inventory_skus_source_type
chk_inventory_skus_source_type.value: "inventory_skus"."source_type" IN ('供应链','市场自采','转让店')

chk_inventory_skus_prices_nonnegative.name: chk_inventory_skus_prices_nonnegative
chk_inventory_skus_prices_nonnegative.value:
COALESCE("inventory_skus"."retail_price", 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE("inventory_skus"."accounting_price", 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE("inventory_skus"."supply_chain_purchase_price", 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE("inventory_skus"."market_purchase_price", 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE("inventory_skus"."store_purchase_price", 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE("inventory_skus"."market_staff_purchase_price", 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE("inventory_skus"."item_company_purchase_price", 0) >= 0
